title: Data Cabling Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Cabling Engineer
Location: Meriden, West Midlands
Salary: £31,940 + Car Allowance

About the Role

Fusion People are currently seeking an experienced Data Cabling Engineer (PSE) to join a busy and growing team working on commercial and industrial projects throughout the Midlands region. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled engineer with experience in structured cabling installations, network infrastructure, and physical security systems.

As a Data Cabling Engineer, you will be responsible for the installation, termination, testing, and commissioning of copper and fibre optic cabling systems while ensuring all work is completed to industry standards and client specifications.

Key Responsibilities

- Installation of Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6A and fibre optic cabling systems
- Containment installation including tray, basket, trunking and conduit
- Termination and testing of copper and fibre cabling
- Installation of network cabinets, patch panels and associated hardware
- Reading and interpreting technical drawings and site plans
- Quality testing and certification using industry-standard equipment
- Working on commercial, industrial and public sector sites
- Maintaining high standards of health and safety on site
- Completing project documentation and test reports

Requirements

- Proven experience as a Data Cabling Engineer
- Strong knowledge of structured cabling systems
- Experience with copper and fibre installations
- Ability to test and certify installations
- ECS/CSCS Card
- Full UK driving licence
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

Desirable

- PSE (Physical Security Engineer) experience
- CCTV, Access Control or Intruder Alarm installation experience
- IPAF and PASMA certifications
- Fibre splicing certification
- First Aid qualification
